summary.intent: Resolve PR review threads and configure CodeRabbit to exclude the api-client package so the PR isn't skipped due to too many changed files.
summary.outcome: Three PR threads were resolved (two code fixes, one marked not applicable), and .coderabbit.yaml was updated to exclude the api-client package and committed.

repo: The api-client package is generated by orval and produces a high file count that can cause CodeRabbit to skip PR reviews entirely.
core/package.json version must be kept in sync with the manifest version (0.24.2); they had drifted to 0.1.0.
FolderTree.set() was zeroing caller-provided key buffers — key material must be cloned before use.

code.finding: Version was misaligned at 0.1.0 instead of 0.24.2 to match the manifest.
set() was mutating/zeroing the caller-supplied key buffer; fix was to clone key material on ingestion.
CodeRabbit path exclusions can be used to reduce file count and avoid the review-skip threshold.

workflow: CodeRabbit has a file-count threshold beyond which it skips PR review entirely; excluding generated packages is a viable workaround.
orval-generated type aliases (e.g. teeKeysDtoPreviousPublicKey) should not be manually edited — flag as not applicable in reviews.

friction: CodeRabbit silently skipped the PR review due to file count, requiring manual investigation of the comment to diagnose.
open_items: Verify that excluding api-client from CodeRabbit is sufficient to bring the file count below the threshold on PR #296.
Consider whether other generated packages should also be excluded from CodeRabbit reviews proactively.
